title: Mini Build: A Complete Article Page
prompt:
Put it all together: build a complete article page titled `My Weekend Project`.

Requirements:
- Full document skeleton: doctype, `html lang`, `head` with charset and `title`, `body`.
- One `h1` with the article title.
- Two paragraphs of story.
- One `h2` section called `What I learned` with at least one paragraph.
